test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The mean and mode of a set of data are 58.7 and 61.1, respectively. Find the median of the data, using the empirical formula.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **empirical relationship** between central tendencies is: 3 × **Median** = **Mode** + 2 × **Mean**

3 × Median = 61.1 + 2 × 58.7

3 × Median = 61.1 + 117.4 = 178.5

Median = 178.5 ÷ 3 = 59.5

**∴ The correct answer is 59.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Mean** of the data = 58.7

**Mode** of the data = 61.1

**Formula Used:**

Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/677f028b625b7155f9508dc8035e0d044f1b0e6636299c6ff6d900bbf5d3c00a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 61.1 = 3 × Median − 2 × 58.7

⇒ 61.1 = 3 × Median − 117.4

⇒ 3 × Median = 61.1 + 117.4

⇒ 3 × Median = 178.5

⇒ Median = 178.5 ÷ 3

⇒ Median = 59.5

**∴ The correct answer is 59.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Symmetric Distribution

In a perfectly **symmetrical distribution**, the Mean, Median, and Mode are all equal (Mean = Median = Mode).

Positive Skewness

In a **positively skewed** distribution, the values generally follow the order: Mean > Median > Mode.

Negative Skewness

In a **negatively skewed** distribution, the values generally follow the order: Mode > Median > Mean.

Empirical Rule Scope

The relationship **Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean** is an approximation used for moderately skewed unimodal distributions.</p
